result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom tab bar all render consistently. Excluding the expected horizontal carousel clipping and bottom viewport cutoff, one minor content issue remains: the search placeholder contains a spelling error ('Restarants').

issues.description: Search bar placeholder text reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
